why_best: Anchoring the background's chromatic radiance to an underlying temporal cadence establishes focus and energy without cluttering the high-density dashboard.
why_bad: Relying on sweeping foreground motion or invasive object transitions would disrupt data readability and breach the professional composure required for an executive view.
trap: A near-miss will turn the smooth, synchronized rise of ambient light into a chaotic strobe or a harsh alarm-like flash.
